I love finding inexpensive ways to do things from around the house. On the burned out panzer III I actually based coat with a textured spray can from spraying my deck chairs to have the metal look more distressed. I also buy those giant dollar store packs of brushes and that way I don't have to use nice ones for the rough work.

The terrain is a base from the Revell Stalingrad kit, I used tempura paints mixed with sand and some diorama dirt and Elmer's glue. Multiple layers of the different colors going from Light to dark. I tried to create very thick layers of glue on top of each other on the road. I also dabbed in some Water Effects in the tracks and the dug in tank pit. Touched up with a round brush. After I finished I coated with Flat clear then 2 coats of gloss clear to wet areas. Finally, I found some cool stones around the yard and painted them to match the terrain. Ad some sticks and fake plants, paint it all in and call it never done.
